summary: Replaced greedy booking with exact chronological branch-and-bound assignment, civil-time fold/gap resolution, directed consecutive-person setup checks, dependencies, room blocks, and deterministic global objective tie-breaking.
tests_run: functions.tests: public.test.mjs and candidate.test.mjs; 9 tests passed, 0 failed
60 seeded small-instance comparisons against an independent exhaustive assignment oracle
limitations: Civil-time resolution is scoped to the specified zones and 2024–2026, using the Node runtime Intl timezone database.
Exact search has exponential worst-case complexity and is intended for the stated maximum of 10 meetings and 3 rooms.
Assumes well-formed inputs and known references as specified; no live calendar access or external calls.
